svg.title: BRIDGING THE WAIT FOR DEPOT POWER
svg.desc: Timeline of 0 to 24 months after buses arrive at a depot, assuming the utility request goes in at the same time. Buses are on site from month 0; chargers can be installed in about 4 weeks; utility construction for fleet power takes 9 to 24 months at one utility, and a new transformer about a year. Large upgrades can take 3 to 5 years or more. The gap can be bridged by phasing in fewer buses, managed charging, a temporary charger, an on-site battery, or delivered energy from AXIVAI.
svg.text: Buses and chargers can be ready within weeks.
Utility power for the fleet can take a year
